title: Guest Dietary and Access Needs
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:rsvp response=yes
| stats count by dietary_need
| sort - count
description: Summarises the dietary and accessibility needs of attending guests so caterers and venues can prepare.
value: Getting needs right shows guests they matter and avoids awkward gaps on the day.
implementation: Ingest RSVP dietary fields into `index=personal`; tally needs across attending guests.
visualization: Bar chart of guest dietary and access needs.
grandmaExplanation: It counts up guests' food and access needs, so the caterer and venue can look after everyone.
